parameters.name: AliyunOrderId
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud order ID. This includes virtual orders.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the activation code.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the activation code. It can contain only letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). This name is used as the filename when you download the activation code from the console.

parameters.name: SystemIdentifier
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the database. This parameter is required if \`AllowEmptySystemIdentifier\` for the order is set to \`false\`.
